newsitem.title: USA: Mission West execs resign, successors named.
newsitem.headline: Mission West execs resign, successors named.

text.p: Mission West Properties said Tuesday that J. Gregory Kasun, president, chief executive officer and director, and Harve Filuk, vice president, have resigned from their positions with the company.
The company said in a release that the resignations come following completion of the sale of substantially all of its real estate assets earlier this year.
Mission West added that Richard Tartre also resigned as a director of the company.
Succeeding Kasun and Filuk are Michael Earley, president and CEO, and Mark Foletta, vice president, the company said.
Earley and Foletta are presently directors of the company and executive officers of Triton Group Ltd, Mission West's largest shareholder.
Katrina Thompson, the company's chief financial officer, continues in her position, Mission West added.
